t: When you have been told you amount to nothing
a: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
p: Innā aʿṭaynāka-l-kawthar, fa-ṣalli li-rabbika wa-nḥar, inna shāni'aka huwa-l-abtar.
m: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar. So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone]. Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
